senses.gloss: ch., usu. pl. <cite ref="B00646"><he>בֵּינֵי</he></cite> ch. same.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:6">Targ. Gen. I, 6</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 114a">Ḥull. 114ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 132b:11">Sabb. 132ᵇ</cite> <he>אתיא מִבֵּינַיָּיא</he> from between the two (from both cases combined) it may be concluded.—<he>מאי בֵינַיְיהוּ</he> (abbr. <he>מ״ב</he>) wherein do they differ? <he>איכא בינייהו</he> (abbr. <he>א״ב</he>) they differ as to … <cite ref="Bava Metzia 15b:16">B. Mets. 15ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>ביני וביני</he>

<cite ref="Chullin 47a:4">Ḥull. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא ב׳ וב׳</he> a case (of an abnormal lobe) between the normal lungs. [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 9:9">Targ. Am. IX, 9</cite> <he>מִבֵּינָהּ</he>, Var. <cite ref="M00085"><he>מבינא</he></cite>, read <he>מִבֵּינֵיה</he> from between its meshes.]
